role: targeted post-hoc context-decomposition and preprocessing-robustness analyses

primary_context_decomposition.fit_policy: jointly optimized using training rows only; validation rows used only for early stopping

interpretation.negative_additive_vs_structure: tissue-specific location shifts add predictive value beyond molecule-only prediction
interpretation.negative_context_vs_additive: the tissue-context benefit is not fully explained by tissue-specific mean shifts and supports predictive non-additivity
interpretation.mechanistic_caveat: predictive non-additivity is not direct evidence of a biological mechanism

loto_raw_fraction_robustness.preprocessing: four fraction columns retained on their native fraction scale; acidic_phospholipid_mg_g converted to g/g by division by 1000; no centering or statistical scaling
loto_raw_fraction_robustness.rationale: remove train-tissue standard-deviation amplification and harmonize the sole mg/g column to a mass fraction without selecting a data-tuned clipping threshold
loto_raw_fraction_robustness.uncertainty: resample tissues equally and parent_group_id clusters within tissue after averaging five training-seed predictions
loto_raw_fraction_robustness.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across four architecture-specific early-versus-late sensitivity tests
exploratory_diagnostics: per-heldout-tissue maximum absolute train-only z score under the original preprocessing
nearest-training-tissue Euclidean distance in the original train-only standardized descriptor space
Spearman association between descriptor extrapolation magnitude and early-minus-late RMSE

interpretation.late_advantage_persists: late-fusion robustness is not explained solely by z-score amplification of adipose physiology
interpretation.adipose_only_changes: the extreme adipose result is preprocessing-sensitive but the cross-tissue direction may remain
interpretation.late_advantage_disappears: the injection-position conclusion must be narrowed to the original standardization pipeline
